payload.title: p.apyr.us documentation: live numbers for static sites
payload.description:
Final story of the epic. The snapshot, the public JSON files, the islands and freshness are covered at https://p.apyr.us/reader-votes-and-ratings.html; the Markdown twins, llms.txt and page actions that make the site agent-readable are at https://p.apyr.us/agent-accessible.html. Extend when the ranked board component ships (PPY-e870bb).

```gherkin
Feature: p.apyr.us documentation
  Scenario: Documented
    Given the feature is live on a pilot site
    Then p.apyr.us has a page describing it, with setup steps and a link to the pilot
```
